emails.subject: For Senthil: an assistant for the candidate admin you described
emails.body:
Hi Senthil,

I saw your August LinkedIn question about keeping inbound candidates, skills and past contact notes organized in Excel. If that is still taking time away from client work, this may be relevant.

I'm Noah, founder of Hirelix: an AI recruiting assistant for USD $49/month. The idea is an assistant's help without another salary: hand over organizing candidate records and notes, preparation for conversations, and client-update drafts. Saved records give your assistant context for later work, so you spend less time rebuilding the same background.

Try your assistant: https://hirelix.online/?utm_source=founder_email&utm_campaign=recruiting_assistant&utm_content=vruksha_intent

The trial is 7 days with 200 AI credits, no card or automatic paid conversion. Use your own workspace and choose what gets shared or sent.

Noah Jiang
Founder, Hirelix
noah@hirelix.online

If this is not relevant, reply "opt out" and I will not email again.
